0.0: This is your fourth time, right? You're making good progress now. For this one, bring me #b#t4007006##k.

yes.0: #b#t4007006##k can be obtained by refining #r#t4020000##k or #r#t4004000##k. Since they are rather rare, it will require some patience. I wish you luck.

no.0: You must train your skills diligently. Come back when you have the time.
